title: Annotator in the Loop: A Case Study of In-Depth Rater Engagement to Create a Bridging Benchmark Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through cognitive interviews, weekly check-ins, and post-project exit surveys asking annotators to reflect on how their personal judgments, life experiences, and social backgrounds influenced their objectivity in labeling nuanced social attributes. This is paired with quantitative measurement of Inter-Rater Reliability (Krippendorff's alpha).

Qualitative analysis of annotator feedback assessing how differences in cultural backgrounds, geographic locations, and localized knowledge (e.g., familiarity with Canadian politics or Catholic teachings) affected their interpretation and annotation of online comments.
Self-reported qualitative feedback evaluating the annotators' ability to remain objective when exposed to polarizing political content (e.g., far-right political commentary).
